source.title: Orion - Golden Prince
source.name: Orion
source.description: The Prince of the Lightbearer Empire who fights with masterful swordplay and enchantments.

skills.name: Fatal Waltz

description.raw: Orion summons a magical rapier at a designated location. For the next 1.5s, it rapidly slashes all enemies within 1 tile, dealing 60% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage 8 times. After that, the rapier erupts in a burst of magic, dealing 420% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage once more and stunning enemies within range for 3 + 0.3 (SP-based)s.
active: Orion summons a magical rapier at a designated location.
For the next 1.5s, it rapidly slashes all enemies within 1 tile, dealing 60% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage 8 times.
After that, the rapier erupts in a burst of magic, dealing 420% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage once more and stunning enemies within range for 3 + 0.3 (SP-based)s.

text: Increases rapier slash damage to 70% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based), and the final magic burst damage to 460% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based).
Increases rapier slash damage to 80% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based), and the final magic burst damage to 500% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based).
Increases rapier slash damage to 90% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based), and the final magic burst damage to 540% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based).
Increases rapier slash damage to 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based), and the final magic burst damage to 600% (ATK-based)+ 40% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Orion summons a magical rapier at a designated location, dealing damage multiple times and stunning enemies.

skills.name: Fervent Flurry

description.raw: Passive. When a battle starts, Orion enchants his rapier for 15 + 2 (SP-based)s. While the enchantment is active, he gains Energy 25% faster, and each instance of damage from his skills or normal attacks applies a stacking Sear effect to enemies for 3s. Each stack of Sear deals damage every second equal to 20% + 2% (SP-based) of the base damage from the instance that applied it. Active. Orion thrusts at the target 4 times in quick succession, dealing 90% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage with each thrust.

skills.description_lite: When a battle starts, Orion enchants his rapier. When this skill is used actively, he deals damage multiple times to the target.

skills.name: Velvet Glove

description.raw: Passive. Whenever an ally grants Orion a temporary stat buff, the enchantment on his rapier is extended by 10s, and that ally becomes his Supporter. Active. Orion unleashes a magical slash in a 1-tile frontal arc, dealing 340% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage and gaining a shield equal to 200% of the damage dealt for 6s. All his Supporters gain 60% of the shield Orion gains.

skills.description_lite: Orion recruits Supporters during battle to empower himself. When this skill is used actively, he strikes enemies in a frontal arc with magical slashes and gains a shield.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Orion increases his ATK by 9% during battle. If he has Supporters on the battlefield, his ATK increases by an extra 6%.

skills.description_lite: Increases ATK, with an extra ATK increase when Supporters are present.

skills.name: Royal Prerogative

description.raw: Every time Orion gains a Supporter, he receives 1 stack of Authority, up to 3 stacks. Each stack of Authority increases Orion's damage dealt by 14%, reduces his damage taken by 18%, and extends the duration of Sear effects he inflicts by 1s.
active: Every time Orion gains a Supporter, he receives 1 stack of Authority, up to 3 stacks.
Each stack of Authority increases Orion's damage dealt by 14%, reduces his damage taken by 18%, and extends the duration of Sear effects he inflicts by 1s.

text: Increases the damage dealt bonus Orion gains from each Authority stack to 16%.
At 3 Authority stacks, Orion unleashes his full power, permanently activating his rapier enchantment.
In addition, his Sear effect is upgraded for the rest of the battle: enemies afflicted for 3s are silenced and have their Vitality reduced by 60 until Sear expires.
Increases the damage dealt bonus Orion gains from each Authority stack to 18%.

skills.description_lite: Orion gains Authority from his Supporters. Each stack of Authority increases Orion's damage dealt and reduces his damage taken.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: After gaining a total of 3 Authority stacks, Orion becomes unaffected for the rest of the battle, and the Sear effect he inflicts deals extra true damage equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
active: After gaining a total of 3 Authority stacks, Orion becomes unaffected for the rest of the battle, and the Sear effect he inflicts deals extra true damage equal to 50% of the damage dealt.

skills.description_lite: After gaining a certain number of Authority stacks, Orion becomes unaffected, and the Sear effect he inflicts deals extra true damage.
